scope:
Full-coverage point-sampled web/guide compatibility screen for rigid V3-style guides.

For every saved equilibrium and every requested guide, dense samples of the
actual module-body surface near the guide are beam-mapped (same exact
constant-strain-cell map as the Boolean audits), expressed in the guide's rigid
station frame and evaluated against the guide, cap and lockwire-envelope
surfaces with a signed distance (negative = body point inside a guide part).

The screen also reports the relative motion of the body at the proposed bond
land with respect to the rigid guide and the implied bond-line shear strain
(axial relative displacement / nominal bond gap). This is a kinematic screen of
the homogenised beam map, not solid FEA, adhesive qualification or a contact
solution. A sampled point set can miss very thin slivers; results are
cross-checked against the existing manifold Boolean audits.

guide_design.status: socket-relief engineering candidate; not released for manufacture
guide_design.axial_retention: Outer-web stations: only the central 0.5 mm land is a proposed bond zone; flared mouths are unbonded relief. Inner-web stations retain the V2 socket. Bond strength and retention are unvalidated.
guide_design.adhesive: Unspecified pending PA12 surface preparation, actual bond gap and pull/shear coupon tests
guide_design.radial_retention: Removable inward socket caps retained by 0.35 mm stainless lockwire in a 0.45 mm groove; CAD models a conservative square-section wire envelope, closure tail excluded.
guide_design.mounting_webs: CAD-derived rectangular webs: radius ~6.896 mm at +/-24 mm stations, ~19.229 mm at +/-12 mm; sockets follow the actual web slope.
guide_design.mounting_stiffness: Four webs remain connected by a rigid frame. No claim that relief decouples their motion or preserves homogenised stiffness.
guide_design.body_source: ../guides_v2; unchanged module bodies, disks, anchors and 21/24/28 mm lanes

sampling.note: Random area-weighted samples of complete-body faces near each guide; sliver-depth sensitivity is limited by spacing and the 0.005 mm mesh tolerance used elsewhere.
